card.name: Word endings in warning headings
card.fires_on: The ending piece of a long word split into parts, such as -ion in Ingestion or INFUSION and -CTIONS in INFECTIONS, mostly in boxed WARNING headings. It also fires on a few split rare words in general text.

modes.label: Warning heading endings
modes.description: Final piece of a split noun like ingestion, infusion or infections right after the word WARNING.
modes.example: WARNINGS : Ingest<<ion>> of more than 3 grams of omega

modes.label: Split words in general text
modes.description: Middle piece of a rare or long word in ordinary prose.
